workflows.name: Plan a family dinner: a restaurant option on OpenTable and a cook-at-home backup on Allrecipes
steps: In the OpenTable tab, click the search box, type "{cuisine} {area}" and press Enter
Open the first restaurant and note its name, rating and price range. Do not click a time slot or Reserve
Switch to the Allrecipes tab, click the search box, type "{dish}" and press Enter; open the first recipe with 4 or more stars and note its name and total time
Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "Dinner: out at <restaurant> (<rating>, <price>, {area}) or cook <recipe> (<time>)" and press Enter

workflows.name: Plan a one-night road-trip stopover: town facts on Wikipedia and a room on Booking.com
steps: In the Wikipedia tab, click the search box, type {town} and open the town's article
Note its population and one landmark mentioned in the introduction
Switch to the Booking.com tab, click the destination box, type {town}, set the dates {checkin} to {checkout} and click Search
Open the first property with a review score of 8 or more and note its name and price. Do not click Reserve or I'll reserve
Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "Stopover {town} {checkin}: <property> <price>. See <landmark> (pop <population>)" and press Enter

workflows.name: Set up a call with a relative abroad: their local time and weather, then email the family
steps: In the timeanddate tab, click the search box, type {city}, press Enter and open its current local time page; note the time and the time difference
Switch to the weather.com tab, click the search box, type {city}, pick it from the list, open the 10 Day forecast and note the forecast for {day}
Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type family@example.com, click Subject and type "Call with {relative} on {day}"
Click Body and type "Calling {relative} on {day}. It is <time> in {city} now (<difference>), forecast there: <forecast>." Do not click Send. Click Discard

FAMILYCALL.3.note: In step 1, first type "Singaproe", notice the typo, fix it to "Singapore", then continue

noise.N1: Open a new tab, go to bbc.com/news, scroll through the headlines, open one story, skim it, close the tab
noise.N2: Open a new tab, go to news.ycombinator.com, scroll the front page, open one comment thread, close the tab
noise.N3: Abandoned attempt: in the Allrecipes tab, search "banana bread", scroll the results, then give up without opening any
noise.N4: Wander: click through the Notes, Mail and Wikipedia tabs without doing anything, scroll the Notes list
noise.N5: Open a new tab, go to imdb.com, scroll the home page, open one title, skim it, close the tab
